title: Cash Pickup Shortfall Re-issue: The Customer's Choice and Its Tool
content:
## Situation

After Paloma's error-resolution team has found that the payout location handed the recipient less cash than the disclosed amount on a Cash Pickup transfer, the customer may choose to have the missing cash collected under a re-issue of the shortfall. The choice is the customer's own.

The choice is recorded on the customer's incorrect-amount error notice together with the re-issue. The re-issue makes the cash collectable again from the day of the choice, under a new Pickup Number.

## The tool and who runs it

The tool is `choose_shortfall_reissue_92bb83b1`, and it belongs to the customer. The agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it in their own name. The agent does not run it on the customer's behalf.

## What one call does

- It records the choice, a re-issue of the shortfall, on the customer's incorrect-amount error notice.
- It re-issues the Cash Pickup transfer at once. The transfer becomes ready for pickup again under a brand-new 10-digit Paloma Pickup Number, which replaces the old one.
- The cash is collectable from today. The last day of collection is today plus the window days given in the call.
- The transfer's collection date and closing date are cleared.

The recipient can collect with the new Pickup Number from today. The receipt shows the recorded choice and the new pickup details.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `cash_transfer_id` | The reference number of the Cash Pickup transfer whose payout was short, as returned by the Cash Pickup transfer lookup for this customer | identifier |
| `related_case_id` | The case reference number of the customer's incorrect-amount error notice on that transfer, as returned by the Cash Pickup case lookup; it is the notice the error-resolution finding answers | identifier |
| `reissue_window_days` | The number of calendar days in the pickup window of the re-issue; the last day of collection becomes today's date plus this many days | whole non-negative integer |

## Return

A successful call returns a receipt with these fields:
- `status`: "recorded" when the choice and the re-issue were written;
- `case_id`: the case reference of the recorded choice;
- `remedy_choice`: always `reissue_shortfall`;
- `pickup_reference`: the new 10-digit Paloma Pickup Number;
- `available_date`: today;
- `pickup_expiry_date`: the new last day of collection;
- `transfer_status`: always `ready_for_pickup`.
